children: Meta Platforms (META) said Reality Labs lost $19 billion last year. Outlook tied improvement to Muse AI hardware integration, availability of compelling apps, and consumer trust around AI privacy.
Meta Platforms (META) is among hyperscalers set to take part in ~$4.2T capex through 2029 and ~$1.1T data‑center spend through 2027; financing via debt and productivity gains cited.
Meta Platforms (META): Muse AI assistant launched in U.S. on Sept. 8, hit No.1 free app for five days; offers free tier plus $20 and $100 monthly subscriptions.
Meta Platforms (META) expanded Muse retail partnerships with Walmart, Best Buy and Gap. Muse finds products, recommends items and can complete purchases, targeting revenue via transaction fees.
Meta delayed Muse launch, prioritizing privacy and security; CEO Zuckerberg said trust and alignment are as crucial as AI power, so a stronger Muse build was postponed for better protections.
Meta unveils strap-free VR Glasses for spring 2027, $1,299.99. ~100g headset uses a tethered Qualcomm Snapdragon Reality Elite puck, 5K micro-OLED display, eye/hand/voice controls, Dolby support.
Meta launched Muse AI assistant with integrations to Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Docs, enabling Muse to access and interact with these services as part of user workflows.
META pivots from metaverse branding, unveils 2027 VR glasses at $1,299, audio smartglasses, updated Ray-Ban Meta (Lisa collab), Ray-Ban Display hologram calling, and ongoing AI investment.
Meta says Muse AI assistant does not route user data into its ad systems, addressing concerns about AI agents' data flow and impact on its ad-driven business.
Analysts say Meta Platforms (META) could unveil a large‑language model codenamed Watermelon at or after Connect, a potential catalyst for META stock around the event timing.
